issues.on_page: Transfers - operations: Governmental (12,484), Business-Type (358,739), Total (371,224); budget schedule p7 'Transfers out 371,224' with no transfers in
issues.issue: Transfers net out of the primary government by 371,224, and no fund receives them. This is a one-sided transfer, and the report doesn't say where the money went. Also, the Garbage Fund 'Operating transfers out' is printed as a positive 4,182 (p6). The extraction has no decision_needed entry for this.

This line is all utility fund charges. Under the user's 2026-10-28 rule it fits Utility Charges, and the matching detail lines already use Utility Charges, so the two don't agree. The 'Fees' line receipts[9] has the same problem.

Golf course operating revenue fits the user's Recreation Fees category (golf), and its detail_category is already recreation/pool/park fees. However, the printed label is only 'Other operating', so the source is assumed.
Golf course spending is tagged function 'utilities', but a golf course is a recreation enterprise, not a utility.
